titulo: DUAS FESTAS PARA O MESMO NAMORADO
personagens: Malu, a woman around 29 with long straight black hair and a red dress; Renata, a woman around 28 with blonde curls, a gold dress carrying golden balloons; Icaro, a man around 31 with short brown hair and a white shirt
cenario: an elegant restaurant private dining room at night with party decorations and two birthday cakes
cenas: Party guests in a dark restaurant room, lights off, a blonde woman entering carrying a birthday cake
Malu setting up birthday decorations at a restaurant table, a waiter asking about a second decoration
Renata entering with golden balloons, a gift bag and a cake almost identical to the one on the table
The whole room silent, ice falling in glasses, Malu and Renata staring at each other
Renata showing photos on her phone to Malu, both shocked
Icaro appearing at the door, freezing when he sees two cakes and two women
Malu asking guests not to film, leading Renata away from the crowd
Malu and Renata comparing message dates on their phones at a corner table
Malu and Renata sharing the two cakes with friends at a long table
Guests dancing joyfully while Icaro leaves through the door, unlit candles on the cakes
